evals.name: Verified B2B Operational Problem Discovery & Experiment Scoping
evals.prompt: Execute evidence-driven problem discovery on Subcontractor Certificate of Insurance (COI) expiration tracking where 8 general contractors provided sanitized Excel shadow sheets and fine receipts ($5,000 legal liability, $150/mo Zapier spend).
evals.expected_output: Verifies attached Level 1 primary behavioral evidence, maps 14-node workflow, computes Research Prioritization score >= 28 PTS, checks multi-dimensional alternatives, and designs a low-cost concierge trial before code.
assertions: Deconstructs workflow using 14-node forensic mapping
Verifies primary behavioral evidence artifacts and sources
Computes 35-point research prioritization score
Designs low-cost validation experiment before writing software

evals.name: Unverified Input Detection & Research Prioritization Guard
evals.prompt: Evaluate an asserted developer tool problem where a user claims microservice REST API schemas drift between NestJS services and asks for immediate full-stack SaaS code without attaching CI logs, error traces, or customer interview quotes.
evals.expected_output: Flags input as unverified assertions without primary evidence artifacts, sets validation status to UNVERIFIED / RESEARCH_PRIORITY, enforces the unverified input hard gate, and demands error logs or developer shadowing before code.
assertions: Detects unverified input claims lacking primary evidence artifacts
Enforces unverified input hard gate without marking validated
Assigns research priority tier rather than build status
Requests concrete primary artifacts like CI logs or traces

evals.name: Track B Free Utility / Civic Workflow Evaluation
evals.prompt: Evaluate a proposed civic helper tool for village cardholders tracking public ration shop stock arrivals and token queue wait times in Tamil Nadu based on field interviews with 12 residents and photos of morning queue registers.
evals.expected_output: Routes candidate to Track B (Free Utility / Public Benefit), replaces WTP with utility/time-saved adoption, checks local language/offline mobile constraints, and scopes a standalone static web utility without penalizing for zero commercial WTP.
assertions: Routes candidate to Track B for free public utility
Evaluates utility time saved and adoption instead of dollar WTP
Enforces offline-first and vernacular device constraints
Scopes smallest suitable solution as static client utility

evals.name: Multi-Dimensional Alternative Fit & Non-Software Audit
evals.prompt: Evaluate a freelance invoice generator candidate where 3 global SaaS tools exist under $50/month (Wave, Invoice Ninja), but a local guild of physical handicraft artisans in a semi-urban cluster cannot use them due to lack of local GST invoice compliance, English-only interfaces, and mandatory credit card billing.
evals.expected_output: Performs multi-dimensional alternative audit (evaluating language, geography, local tax compliance, and device constraints), checks non-software options (printed bill book vs mobile utility), and determines true workflow fit rather than blindly archiving based on competitor count.
assertions: Evaluates multi-dimensional competitor fit beyond pricing
Assesses local tax compliance language and device constraints
Audits non-software alternatives like printable bill books
Distinguishes generic SaaS saturation from acute local gaps

evals.name: No-Problem Fallback Anti-Hallucination Rejection
evals.prompt: Evaluate user feedback stating that users find a dashboard header icon slightly unintuitive, with zero operational consequence, zero wasted hours, and no maintained workaround.
evals.expected_output: Classifies friction as cosmetic complaint, calculates priority score < 15 PTS, rejects premature solution prototyping, and outputs mandatory anti-hallucination fallback message.
assertions: Classifies friction as cosmetic complaint or inconvenience
Calculates 35-point score below 15 points
Outputs mandatory no-problem fallback message
Rejects premature solution prototyping

evals.name: Messy Regional Prompt Semantic Parsing & Epistemic Hygiene
evals.prompt: Parse and deconstruct a messy regional user prompt: 'My uncle does real estate in Pollachi, WhatsApp is messy with photos, buyers delay token advance, and sub-registrar office has huge queues for EC. Can we find a problem here?'
evals.expected_output: Strips conversational filler while preserving second-hand provenance ('uncle'), categorizes facts, reported frictions, and explicit unknowns separately, formulates separate candidate query hypotheses without converting physical queues into digital timeouts without evidence, and decomposes into matching adaptive research lenses without inventing unrelated streams.
assertions: Preserves second-hand provenance without discarding attribution as filler
Categorizes user facts, reported frictions, and explicit unknowns separately
Formulates separate candidate query hypotheses for physical vs digital friction
Decomposes into matching adaptive research lenses without inventing unrelated streams
